checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Frames are 854x480 (16:9) and span 6 s. Playability looks fine from the sampled frames.

must.item: Stripes, rocky coast and composition match first-turn picture
must.why: The red-and-white lighthouse, rocks and sky match the picture. The framing is slightly tighter and the tower sits a bit larger and further right.

must.item: Watercolor look and dusk lighting remain throughout
must.why: The paper texture, washes and orange-purple dusk sky persist in every frame.

must.item: Waves move against rocks and a beam sweeps across the water
must.why: The waves clearly move, but they get large and splashy rather than small. No beam is visible in any frame, only a glowing lamp.

must.item: No added writing or audible sound
must.why: No text appears in any frame. The video was made silent, though audio can't be checked from stills.

faults.what: No visible lighthouse beam sweeping across the water, which was a core requested motion.
Waves grow into large crashing splashes rather than the small rolling waves requested.
Frame is slightly re-cropped or zoomed compared with the source picture, and the foreground water changes in colour and texture.
The scene looks somewhat sharper and more saturated, which weakens the loose watercolor feel in places.

summary: The video keeps the watercolor lighthouse and dusk look with moving waves, but the requested sweeping beam is missing and the waves are bigger than "small".
